verdict.detail: The same year as the first issue (US, KZ 30766, 1971).

physical: Pressed by CBS Pressing Plant, Aston Clinton

notes.text:
Thin gatefold sleeve with red inner sleeve, record is inserted inside the gatefold.

Catalogue numbers: 
"Douglas 9" on top right front cover
"DGL 69014" on top left front cover and spine
"S DGL 69014" on record labels

Track B3 is credited to "P.D. Bob Cornford" on cover, and "P & D Point/B. Cornford" on label.

Publishers:
Copyright Control - A1, A2, B2 to B7
Recording Rights Agency Ltd. - B1
April Music Ltd. - B8 

On sleeve:
This is a Douglas U.S.A. Recording
Douglas is manufactured and distributed by CBS Records
CBS is a Trademark of the Columbia Broadcasting System Inc., U.S.A.
UNIPAK by Shorewood Packaging Co. Ltd., ENGLAND. Patents Pending. 

On labels:
DOUGLAS RECORDS PRODUCED BY CBS RECORDS U.K. 
MADE IN ENGLAND

Runout data is stamped.
